Recorded claim:
The D329733 review reported that its changed browser test covered blank Is values but did not cover blank Isnt values. When reviewing this revision, check that both allowed operators save a blank value and retain the correct operator. This is a reported coverage gap, not proof of an Isnt defect or of current test coverage.
